# Word Game Helper

> Free Crossplay word finder and board solver. Enter your board and tiles to find the highest-scoring move in NYT Crossplay, Scrabble or WWF. No sign-up.

## What is this?

Word Game Helper finds the highest-scoring move for three games. Choose the game so the board, letter values, blanks, and all-tiles bonus match that game:

- **NYT Crossplay** - 40-point sweep for using all 7 tiles, 3 blanks, and no score bonus on the center star. Nine letters differ from Scrabble: B, G, H, J, K, L, U, V, and W.
- **Scrabble** - 50-point bingo, 2 blanks, and a double-word center star.
- **Words with Friends** - 35-point bingo, 2 blanks, and no center bonus.

## How it works

1. Enter the letters already on the game board by clicking cells and typing
2. Enter your 7 available tiles in the tile rack
3. Use ? for a blank. Crossplay allows 3. Scrabble and Words with Friends allow 2.
4. Click "Show Me Best Move" to find the highest-scoring words
5. Click "Place" to add the word to your board

## Scoring

The tool calculates scores based on:
- Letter point values for the selected game
- Bonus squares on that game's board. Newly placed tiles get the bonus. The Crossplay center star marks the opening square and does not multiply the word.
- Cross-word scores
- All-tiles bonus: 40 in Crossplay, 50 in Scrabble, 35 in Words with Friends

## Word list

Crossplay, Scrabble, and Words with Friends all use the same list in this helper: the older North American TWL (178,691 words). NYT Crossplay's official list is NWL2023 with New York Times edits, so some newer words may be missing. Words with Friends has its own official list, which this helper does not load separately.

## Pages

- https://wordgamehelp.com/ — NYT Crossplay word finder. The homepage solver opens on Crossplay.
- https://wordgamehelp.com/scrabble-word-finder — Scrabble word finder. 50-point bingo, 2 blanks, double-word center star.
- https://wordgamehelp.com/words-with-friends-word-finder — Words with Friends word finder. 35-point bingo, 2 blanks, no center star.
- https://wordgamehelp.com/crossplay-tile-values — Crossplay letter points, including the nine letters that differ from Scrabble.
- https://wordgamehelp.com/crossplay-board-layout — Crossplay bonus squares. The center star does not multiply the score.

## Privacy

This tool runs entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server. Game state is saved in your browser's local storage.
